name: multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills — 194K Stars; 4 Rules From Karpathy That Stop Claude Breaking Code
hook: A single CLAUDE.md encoding Andrej Karpathy's four behavioral rules for LLM coding: Think Before Coding, Simplicity First, Surgical Changes, Goal-Driven Execution. The rules block four failure modes Karpathy documented directly — unfounded assumptions, unnecessary abstraction, unintended side-effects, and vague success criteria. 194K stars and still climbing after debuting in January 2026 as one of the fastest-growing AI workflow repos ever. MIT. Available as a plugin or direct CLAUDE.md drop-in.

name: Claude Code v2.1.212 — /fork → Background Sessions; /subtask New; MCP Auto-Background at 2 Min; WebSearch Cap
hook: Released today (July 17). Five headline changes: (1) /fork now copies your conversation into a new background session visible in `claude agents` while you keep working — the old in-session subagent is renamed /subtask; (2) /resume now lets you pick and resume any past session as a background agent; (3) MCP tool calls running longer than 2 minutes automatically move to background, preventing UI lockups; (4) WebSearch is capped at 200 calls/session (tunable) to stop runaway research loops; (5) subagent spawns capped at 200/session with /clear resetting the budget. Also: prompt caching now works behind Bedrock and Vertex gateways, reduced inter-agent token usage, and a worktree symlink security fix.

name: Claude Reflect — Anthropic's Usage Dashboard; AI Fluency Score; Quiet Hours; Launched July 9
hook: Anthropic's built-in usage dashboard, launched July 9 in beta. Tracks topics, task types, and patterns across 1/3/6/12-month windows. Reports your AI Fluency score across four dimensions — Delegation, Description, Discernment, Diligence — and nudges you to set quiet hours or take breaks. Excludes incognito chats and health-tool data. Free for Pro and Max users with memory on; found in Settings on claude.ai and the desktop app. TechCrunch: 'Anthropic's new Claude feature is quietly selling you on AI.'
